_about: Manual corrections applied on top of the automatic extraction. Every entry says what the source PDF contains and why it was changed. Question numbers are the official numbers from the question bank.

nepali.reason: Stray '(' from the option marker that the source split across two lines.
Misspelled English word inside the Nepali option.
Stray vowel sign in source that renders as a broken cluster.
Misspelled English words inside the Nepali option.

nepali.to: घरपालुवा जन्तु / जंगल / जंगल, वन्यजन्तु आरक्ष / चिडियाखाना
nepali.reason: These four options are typed in the legacy Preeti font (no Unicode text layer); converted and checked against the page image and OCR.

english.to: Switch on the headlights and turn
english.reason: Capitalisation.

english.to: In which gear should the vehicle be during overtaking?
english.reason: Missing question mark.

english.reason: Mistranslation: हिलो means mud, not water.

english.to: Black letters on a yellow plate
english.reason: Garbled translation ('Black yellow letter on a yellow plate').
Translation inverted the Nepali meaning ('असंयमित रुपमा सवारी चलाउने').

english.to: According to the Vehicle and Transport Management Act, 2049 and Rules, 2054, what kind of vehicle transfer of ownership cannot be done?

english.reason: Grammar.
Mistranslation: रतन्धो means night blindness, not colour blindness.

english.reason: Translation added 'and vehicle seizure', which is not in the Nepali option.
Casing.

Mistranslation ('Non of the above').

english.reason: Garbled translation ('to turn the a lateral position').
